subject: Application: Asset Engineer, Whitehorse City Council, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Asset Engineer role at Whitehorse City Council in Nunawading, closing 18 October 2026.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as project-in-charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I do not yet have Australian local-government employment, and I am not a Registered Professional Engineer; I am eligible to work toward registration with further experience.

Your role's focus on drainage and legal point of discharge reviews, road infrastructure advice and engineering plan assessment matches the stormwater and documentation skills from my diploma.

I have attached my resume and a one-page selection criteria statement. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

paragraphs: I am applying for the Asset Engineer role supporting the Engineering Asset Coordinator at Whitehorse City Council, Nunawading, closing Sunday 18 October 2026. The work on engineering plan review, drainage and legal point of discharge applications, and road infrastructure advice is the municipal pathway I want.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019) and in February 2026 finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. That diploma covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, including Before You Dig Australia enquiries and design around existing services.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as Project-in-Charge Engineer and Field Engineer on a community hall renovation and residential subdivision finishing works, including inspections, drawing checks and progress reporting.

I live in Melton Victoria, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I do not yet have Australian local-government experience and I am not currently a Registered Professional Engineer; I understand RPE is desirable and I am willing to work toward registration with mentoring.
Please find my resume and one-page statement addressing the selection criteria. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
